posts.caption:
A remarkable voice of wisdom, experience and purpose. 💙

We are incredibly proud to have Mr. Richard S Oliver OBE as a member of the SmallWorld Foundation Board of Trustees.

During our recent visit to Big Education in Leeds, Mr Richard reflected beautifully on a journey spanning 15 years, 38 countries, 55+ charities and more than 53,000 children.

His words captured both how far SmallWorld has travelled and what continues to unite us: a belief that every child, regardless of circumstance or geography, deserves access to education and opportunity.

Mr. Richard, your wisdom, generosity and commitment have enriched our Foundation enormously. We are privileged, and very proud, to have you as part of the SmallWorld family. 💙

Thank You to Mr. Richard & Ms. Debby 

Some partnerships are built on paper. Others are built in-person,on the ground, where the work is happening.

We are deeply grateful to Mr. Richard and Ms. Debby, both esteemed members of our SmallWorld Foundation Board, for taking the time to visit the National Advice Line Project in London with us this week

Their presence speaks volumes. They didn’t just come to observe, they came to connect. To meet the teams. To understand the youth. To see, feel, and witness the impact of over 2,000

Having leadership that shows up matters. It reminds us all that our work is not only about strategy and funding but about heart, commitment, and being part of something larger than ourselves.

Thank you both for walking alongside us in this mission.

#BoardLeadership #Gratitude #SmallWorldFoundation #HandsOnSupport #SocialImpact #ThankYou

What happens when a young youth who’s been disconnected from school, unsure of their rights, finally hears: “You’re not alone—we’re here to help”?

That’s exactly what the National Advice Line provides. And the results speak volumes.

In just one year, a target of more than 2,000 underprivileged youth in London have received:

✔️ Personalized guidance to return to school after years of absence
✔️ Trusted, accurate information that replaced harmful rumors and confusion
✔️ Help navigating complex systems, from school applications to public services
✔️ Support for their caregivers, strengthening their entire family unit
✔️ New awareness of vocational and educational paths they didn’t know were possible
✔️ Empowerment to take control of their futures
✔️ And most importantly—a renewed sense of hope, dignity, and purpose

This isn’t just an advice line. It’s a lifeline.

Funded and supported by SmallWorld Foundation and implemented by our dedicated partner REUK, this project proves what we believe: when you invest in people, transformation follows.

#YouthImpact #EducationAccess #SmallWorldFoundation #REUK #EmpoweringYouth #TransformingLives #ImpactThatMatters #HopeAndDignity

This week, we had the privilege of visiting the National Advice Line for Underprivileged Youth in London—a project supported and funded by SmallWorld Foundation and implemented with the inspiring team at @refugeeeduk 

 Our president and founder, Mrs Salam Hamzeh , and Our Board members, Mr Richard Oliver and Ms Debby Burton joined us on the ground to witness how this initiative is truly changing lives.

With a target impact of over 2,000 young, underprivileged youth. Who Many of them had been out of school, disconnected, or overwhelmed by complex systems. With the Project, they now receive clear, compassionate guidance that is helping them rebuild confidence, re-enter education, and start imagining new futures.

Seeing the impact reminded us of why we do what we do. The service is not just about advice; it’s about dignity, trust, and empowerment. And we’re so proud to walk this journey with our partners and board members by our side.

#SmallWorldFoundation #OnTheGround #BoardVisit #YouthEmpowerment #EducationThatHeals #CollectiveLeadership

Through this fundraising initiative, we are aiming to achieve the below:

- Helping 6 children get mental support.
- 8 hours of therapy per child for £50 each.
- Total to be raised £2,400.
